items.reason: Pinning 47 action refs to commit SHAs requires resolving each tag against the GitHub API and this session has no network; the repo already has the tooling (`npm run actions:pin` rewrites and self-enforces in one pass), a Dependabot github-actions ecosystem to keep pins fresh, and a ledger row recording the exemption, and the 'broad write' half is already split job-by-job in issue-dispatch.yml/agent-review.yml.

Already covered another way: prepare-commit-msg + commit-msg hooks are auto-installed by `npm install` and write Co-Authored-By plus Agent-Harness/Model/Spec/Session/Lane, commit:check --range reports coverage, and the rubric review lists unattributed commits on every push — the residual is history that cannot be rewritten and hookless throwaway worktrees, which no repository-side change reaches; I did extend the review to also name agent commits that carry no Agent-Harness, which the repo's own guidance calls the field that matters.

MUTANT_FLOOR (7) and per-seam SEAM_FLOORS now fail `npm run test:unit` when the mutation catalogue shrinks, pinned in the contract ledger so lowering either is a two-line reviewed diff rather than a digit — closing the one direction in which the sensitivity measure could get worse with every build staying green.

`npm run llm:candidate` rehearses every registered operation against the successor declared in test-llm/model-candidates.json through the real wrapper (BYOM context, no change to the chokepoint), runs weekly in llm-drift.yml, records `skipped` with no key, and is held to the tree by a census test that goes red the moment GEMINI_MODEL moves and the candidate row does not follow.

The deploy target is now declared as data in .github/environments.json (runtime, six cron schedules, all 74 environment variables classified by what their absence costs and whether they reach the browser) and diffed against vercel.json/package.json/next.config.ts/.env.example/docs/deploy.md/the workflows on every build by test-unit/environment-manifest.test.mjs; it is explicit that it reads the repository and not the Vercel project.

`npm run typecheck:strict:check` now runs on every push and pull request as a reporting step of ci.yml and puts the error count, the ten worst files and the failing rules into the job summary; the baseline in .github/typecheck-strict.json is deliberately unaccepted (no offline session can run tsc) so one `typecheck:strict:accept --reason` promotes it to a one-way ratchet.

lessons: This repository's gates are interlocked by meta-tests, and that is the fact to learn before editing anything: adding a stage to `check:ci` obliges you to add a row to scripts/gate-remedy.mjs (in the same position), a constraint to .github/constraint-map.json AND its table row to AGENTS.md in the same order, and possibly a pin to .github/contract-ledger.json — test-unit/gate-remedy.test.mjs and test-unit/constraint-map.test.mjs fail otherwise. When you cannot run the suite, prefer landing a new blocking check as a unit test (test:unit is already a stage) rather than as a fourteenth stage: same blocking rung, none of the interlocks.

Adding a `continue-on-error: true` step to a job named in .github/required-checks.json is refused by `npm run merge-gate` unless the step's exact `name:` is listed in that job's `softenedSteps`. Reporting-rung steps are welcome; silent ones are not.

A key-gated workflow step cannot be added without declaring it: `npm run harness:degradation:check` fails on any `secrets.NAME` no capability in scripts/harness-degradation.mjs declares, and a non-announcing capability must name a `recordedBy` file that literally contains its `marker` (e.g. `status: "skipped"`).

The LLM chokepoint can be pointed at an arbitrary model from a script WITHOUT touching src/lib: `runWithByomContext({ vendor, apiKey, model, fastModel, reasoning }, () => generateStructured(...))` is how test-llm/quality/run.mjs benchmarks a roster. That is the seam to use for any model experiment here — editing src/lib/llm/models.ts is a CODEOWNERS law-file change and would trip test-unit/llm-model-pin.test.mjs.

`npm run agents:surface` ratchets unmapped files under `src/` only, so new scripts/, test-unit/ and .github/ files do not push that count over its ceiling — but anything you add under src/ does, and the ledger ceiling (159) turns that into a red `contract:ledger:check`.
